items.title: 14.15.2 Hawa ki aaloodgi par qaboo pane ke iqdamat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.15.2, printed pages 318-319.

items: Vehicle emission standard (gariyon ke dhuen ki had): is standard ko lagoo karne ka maqsad motor gariyon se pollution kam karna hai. Saaf fuels, jaise compressed natural gas (CNG) aur liquid petroleum gas (LPG), ko farogh dena, aur fuel ke mayar par sakht zabita (kitab mein 'sticker regulation' chhapa hai, ghaliban 'stricter').
Industrial emission control: factories se emission kam karna, aur factories ko saaf paidawar (cleaner production) ki techniques aur pollution control technologies apnane ki targheeb dena.

Public awareness campaigns (awami aagahi): logon ko air pollution ke sources aur asraat, aur apna hissa kam karne ke tareeqe batana; saath hi public transport, carpooling (mil kar ek gari mein safar) aur bina engine ke transport, jaise cycling aur paidal chalna, ko farogh dena.

Urban planning aur green infrastructure: air quality behtar karne ke liye shehron mein green belts aur parks banana, aur aisi planning karna jo traffic ka rash (congestion) kam kare aur sustainable (dair-pa) transport ko farogh de.

Smog control measures: khaas taur par sardiyon mein, jab air quality bohat gir jati hai, smog control karne ke khaas iqdamat; fasal ki baqiyat (crop residues) jalane par pabandi, jo smog ki bari wajah hai; aur hawa se PM kam karne ke liye smog towers aur doosri technologies ka istemal.
Khuli aag par pabandi: ghar aur factories ka koora khuli aag mein jalane ki mumaniat, kyun ke is se dhool, dhuan aur bohat se air pollutants paida hote hain.
Low-sulphur diesel ka istemal: diesel mein sulphur ki ijazat-shuda miqdar (permissible level) kam karna.

blocks.text: In zawabit aur iqdamat ke zariye Pakistan air quality behtar karna aur awam ki sehat aur environment par air pollution ke bure asraat kam karna chahta hai.

blocks.prompt: Smog control karne ke khaas iqdamat kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Sardiyon par khaas tawajjo: fasal ki baqiyat jalane par pabandi; smog towers aur PM kam karne wali doosri technologies; gariyon ke emission standards aur saaf fuels; factories aur bhattiyon ke emission par control; koora khuli aag mein jalane par pabandi.

items: Iqdamat: vehicle emission standards aur saaf fuels (CNG, LPG); industrial emission control; awami aagahi aur public transport; green belts aur urban planning; smog control (crop residue jalane par pabandi, smog towers); khuli aag par pabandi; low-sulphur diesel.
